verdict.rationale: Ramp docs confirm automatic receipt capture on card swipe with auto-filled memos/categories (ramp-docs-8, ramp-docs-32, ramp-docs-45), and an MCP/CLI tool explicitly designed to find transactions with missing receipts in the last 14 days and draft reminders (ramp-docs-29), matching the 'nudge only when genuinely missing' behavior. However, evidence does not explicitly describe e-receipts being pulled automatically from third-party integrations (e.g., email/vendor e-receipt ingestion) as opposed to receipt capture at swipe time — the QuickBooks/NetSuite integration docs focus on matching/reconciliation of invoices and bills, not e-receipt sourcing. missing for 10: explicit evidence of e-receipt pulling from email/vendor integrations, independent/hands-on confirmation of nudge accuracy and false-positive rate.
